Class Galleon

java.lang.Object
iscteiul.ista.battleship.Ship
iscteiul.ista.battleship.Galleon
All Implemented Interfaces:
IShip
public class Galleon extends Ship
Represents a galleon (Galeao) occupying five positions in a T shape. The bearing selects which side of the shape contains its three-position bar.

  • Constructor Details

    • Galleon

      public Galleon(Compass bearing, IPosition pos) throws java.lang.IllegalArgumentException
      Creates a galleon with its bar on the side indicated by the bearing. The reference position is the leftmost position in the top occupied row; south and east bearings may also occupy columns to its left in lower rows. Board boundaries are checked when adding the ship to a fleet.
      Parameters:
      bearing - the non-null cardinal direction of the galleon
      pos - the non-null reference position for constructing the shape
      Throws:
      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if bearing is Compass.UNKNOWN
      java.lang.NullPointerException - if bearing or pos is null and assertions are disabled
      java.lang.AssertionError - if bearing or pos is null and assertions are enabled
